[An Amalgamation of Predictions and Questions Regarding the Apple Tablet](http://shawnblanc.net/2010/01/tablet-amalgamation/)

Interesting post written by ShawnBlanc that summarize every prediction made by guys like [Gruber](http://daringfireball.net/) and [Marco](http://www.marco.org/) regarding the Apple Tablet.  
I agree with him in almost every aspect because he’s not so optimistic like others, particularly on the “revolutionary OS” thing.
